summary.en: You join your workplace health insurance and employees' pension if you work at a designated employer, and scheduled hours are 20 or more a week. Under this short-time-worker rule (20 hours or more a week), students are in principle not covered, with exceptions (for example on leave of absence or night-school students). If your hours and days are at least three quarters of a full-time worker's, you join even as a student. People hired for 2 months or less are excluded. Under the current rule, a designated employer has 51 or more insured people; from October 2027 this extends to employers with 36 or more (future rule). Employment insurance applies if you are expected to work 31 days or more and 20 hours or more a week. Daytime students are in principle not covered (night-school students, students on leave and some others may be); it follows a separate rule from health insurance and pension. Read the National Health Insurance and National Pension cards on the same day. The wage requirement (¥88,000 a month or more) was abolished on 1 October 2026. evidence.quote: 社会保険については年金事務所へ、 税金については税務署へ、 在留資格については出入国在留管理局へ相談してください。
上記の「特定適用事業所」「任意特定適用事業所」または「国・地方公共団体に属する事業所」に勤務する方で、1週間の所定労働時間または1月の所定労働日数が通常の労働者の4分の3未満である方のうち、週の所定労働時間が20時間以上かつ、学生ではない場合は短時間労働者として健康保険・厚生年金保険の加入対象となります。
